title: Hotels with a Pantheon view: which room to book
metaDescription: Three Rome hotels on Piazza della Rotonda with Pantheon view rooms, the exact category to book, and the rooms that face elsewhere to skip.
h1: Hotels with a Pantheon view, and which room to book
dek: Three hotels on Piazza della Rotonda, the square in front of the Pantheon in Rome. For each one we list the room categories sold with the view, and the rooms that look elsewhere.
teaser: At one hotel the view is guaranteed in the Superior rooms; at the other two it is in the room names.

faq.q: Which Rome hotels sell rooms with a Pantheon view?
faq.a: Of the hotels we checked in October 2026: Albergo del Senato, Hotel Albergo Abruzzi and Antico Albergo del Sole Al Pantheon. Each one sells at least one room category with the Pantheon in its name or its description.

faq.q: Is the Pantheon view guaranteed at Albergo del Senato?
faq.a: Not in every room. The hotel's own page says the Pantheon view is not guaranteed in its Standard Double Rooms, while its Superior Double and Superior Twin rooms are described as having a guaranteed view.

faq.q: Why does a booking site say City view for a Pantheon View suite?
faq.a: Trip.com tags the Deluxe Suite Annex Pantheon View and the Imperial Suite Ariosto Pantheon View at the Antico Albergo del Sole Al Pantheon as City View. The room name is the promise, so book by name.
